author: JuroStage
quote: A game riddled with bugs, clearly with unfair ratings that give undue weight to biased opinions. An unfinished game can't possibly get so many "good reviews"; the media seemed completely bought off. So many bugs on my PS5 Pro, it's a huge disappointment.

author: JuroStage
quote: I honestly expected the game to be good, but it turned out to be perfect. It's incredible to relive this story at this level. Thank you, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
